claims.assertion: Mari says the Federation’s Viera station serves as its local headquarters and flight-control center for Earth; ships must file plans to enter or leave.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari says Centauri are the most numerous star people around Earth, while Antarians patrol space around the planet.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari says Urmah remain members of the local Federation despite disagreeing with it, and describes them as heavily militarized and direct about their intentions.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
